The collections of a collected data frame

get_collections.Rd

Returns the list of collections carried by a collected_df (including a conjoint_df, which is a collected_df). Each collection names a group of columns that belong together - for example, the conjoint attributes of a conjoint_df.

Usage

get_collections(x, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

x

A collected_df.

call

The calling environment, used to report errors. Defaults to the caller of get_collections().

Value

A list of collection objects.

Examples

# A conjoint_df carries one collection per attribute.
cjt <- conjoint_df(example_utilities, example_crosswalk)
get_collections(cjt)
#> [[1]]
#> <collection> Brand
#>   • Northwind
#>   • Cascade
#>   • Meridian
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> <collection> Price (ordered)
#>   • $199
#>   • $299
#>   • $399
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> <collection> Battery (ordered)
#>   • 10 hours
#>   • 20 hours
#>   • 30 hours
#> 
#> [[4]]
#> <collection> Storage (ordered)
#>   • 128 GB
#>   • 256 GB
#>   • 512 GB
#> 
#> [[5]]
#> <collection> Color
#>   • Black
#>   • Silver
#>   • Blue
#>
